newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for May 21.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for May 21.

text.p: - All Mexican ports were open on Wednesday, the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1500 local/2100 GMT daily meteorological report.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Pacific Coast, Gulf of Mexico and Caribbean.

Possible light rains expected later in the day along Baja California peninsula and much of Pacific Coast. Maximum winds of 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 to 16 miles per hour) and waves three to five feet high.
Expected rains and strong winds along coasts of Tamaulipas, Tabasco, Veracruz and Campeche states. Maximum winds 10 to 15 knots and waves four to six feet high.
Hot and partly cloudy with winds from 20 to 30 km per hour.
